description:
[Calculators] Is this door code easy to guess?. The door code page's checker: `verdict` is `good`, `guessable` (a weak pattern: a year, a date, doubled digits,
a mirror, only two digits) or `easy to guess` (a top-10 code, one digit four times, a run, a repeated pair), with
the `reasons`. Check a code BEFORE you set it - don't send the code that's on your door now. Ask for a code the user is THINKING of using, not the one on their door now.
name: check_door_code
title: Is this door code easy to guess?
